history: Kunming has been a city for over 2,400 years, a key node on the ancient Southern Silk Road and the Tea Horse Road. It is called the 'Spring City' for its year-round spring weather and blooming flowers. Dianchi Lake, the Sleeping Beauty hills of Xishan, and the Stone Forest form its landscape. In 1938 the Southwest Associated University moved here — a miracle in Chinese education. Today it is China's gateway to South and Southeast Asia.
importance: Capital of Yunnan · The Spring City · Gateway to South & Southeast Asia
